speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have yellowish coloring in your skin and eyes; can you tell me when these symptoms first started and if you have been feeling unusually tired or confused?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely infectious or toxin-induced).

I have noted your age, recent substance use, and sexual history; given the jaundice and agitation, I need to confirm the liver enzymes and viral status. REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel (AST, ALT, Bilirubin, Alk Phos), Viral Hepatitis Panel (A, B, C), and Toxicology Screen.
